records.title: Basque Legends
ancientAuthors: Basque storytellers, collected chiefly in Labourd by Wentworth Webster
records.translator: Wentworth Webster, with language assistance from Julien Vinson and local contributors
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: Second edition of Basque legends collected chiefly in Labourd. Webster distinguishes local tales from stories he identifies as French-derived and compares some motifs with wider European folklore; preserve each tale's local label and informant where given.
